# geometry type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:geometryType`](gmeow-geometryType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/geometryType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The structural kind of a geometry (a [`gmeow:GeometryType`](../classes/gmeow-GeometryType.md) individual). Non-functional: competing source classifications may differ (e.g. polygon vs multipolygon) and must coexist as evidence.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to classify a geometry by its structural kind; non-functional, so competing source classifications coexist.

### Avoid when

- Avoid encoding the kind as a subclass (polygon vs multipolygon disagreements coexist as evidence).

### How to use

- Attach a [`gmeow:GeometryType`](../classes/gmeow-GeometryType.md) individual to the [`Geometry`](../classes/gmeow-Geometry.md) alongside [`gmeow:asWKT`](gmeow-asWKT.md) / [`gmeow:asGeoJSON`](gmeow-asGeoJSON.md).
